groups.activity: check that the Dual Toxocyst research chain is complete
groups.meta: 4 sequential researches, 72h each if none are done

rows.label: Dual Toxocyst
rows.note: Ghost tier: 5,000 cr, 20 Mutagen Sample, 200 Circuits, 750 Nano Spores, 400 Cryotic

conditions: Each of the four researches takes 72h if none are already done, and the cost multiplies by clan tier — x3 Shadow, x10 Storm, x30 Mountain, x100 Moon.
An established clan has usually already finished this chain; check the Bio Lab before assuming you need to grind it.
bonuses: Drop the clan to Ghost tier before researching if you are doing this solo — costs scale x3/x10/x30/x100 by tier regardless of member count.

conditions: Each player buys their own blueprint after clan research completes.

rows.label: The Steel Path
rows.note: required for the Genesis reward track

groups.sub: Week 5: Torid, Dual Toxocyst, Dual Ichor, Miter, Atomos
groups.activity: choose Dual Toxocyst Incarnon Genesis, then complete Circuit stages
groups.meta: Tier 5 for the first pick, Tier 10 for the second

rows.label: Dual Toxocyst Incarnon Genesis
rows.note: choose it as your first pick, not second

rows.label: Circuit stages
rows.note: Tier 5; the first pick is enough

rows.label: Circuit stages
rows.note: Tier 10; only if taking the second weekly Genesis too (33 with the once-daily bonus progress)

conditions: Dual Toxocyst is only offered during Week 5 of the nine-week rotation, alongside Torid, Dual Ichor, Miter and Atomos; confirm the live offering at Cavalero.
First choice lands at Tier 5 (12 stages), second at Tier 10 (34 stages) — roughly triple the time for the same item.
A failed or aborted stage gives nothing for that stage; only completed stages bank progress.

disclosures.title: missing the week is the grind
disclosures.body: Nine weeks to the next Week 5, and buying with platinum does not escape it — Cavalero only sells the adapters that are in the current rotation, 120p each, once per adapter. Both the weapon and the Genesis are untradeable, so nobody can hand you a finished one.

groups.activity: install Dual Toxocyst Incarnon Genesis, then complete Evolutions

rows.label: Complete Incarnon Evolutions
rows.note: skip Ready Retaliation (EVO3) and Neurotoxin (EVO4), both currently non-functional; take Marksman's Hand or Evolved Autoloader at EVO3, Commodore's Fortune at EVO4

conditions: The EVO4 challenge (17 consecutive headshots) is cheesed on a Teralyst's invulnerable head at night on the Plains of Eidolon; body shots and companion damage reset the counter, status damage does not.
bonuses: Mod for Gas: gas cloud ticks refresh the Frenzy headshot buff, keeping +150% fire rate and infinite ammo running without landing a headshot every few seconds.
Pair with Secondary Encumber: Carnage Reign scales off status types on the target, and Encumber primes it directly.

disclosures.title: Carnage Reign needs Energy Max ≥ 200
disclosures.body: The evolution's +33% direct damage per status type does nothing below that threshold; check the frame before picking it over Fevered Frenzy, whose +5% multishot per ability cast stacks to 20x and persists for the whole mission.
